snippet.title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s official: World of Tanks: HEAT goes live on May 26, 2026!
We've been working toward this moment for a long time, and today, we can finally share the date. HEAT will be free-to-play on PC (Steam and Wargaming Game Center), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam Deck, and GeForce NOW, with full cross-play from day one.
Learn more and wishlist the game: https://wotheat.com 
___
Director: Ilya Naishuller 
Music: "Ring the Bells" by Biting Elbows (https://www.youtube.com/@bitingelbows) 

Follow our socials: https://linktr.ee/wot_heat
Wishlist HEAT:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100280
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011450
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n11jm7f5cxk
